project_context: The supplied English entry is authoritative. Use this context to disambiguate meaning, not add unstated claims, expand short labels into explanations, or silently repair a known source discrepancy. Preserve source numbers, qualifications and placeholders. Return clean Unicode without discretionary soft hyphens or zero-width characters inside words.

Clipboard Resurrection is a Fallout 4 settlement construction mod. Clipboard is its proper product/device name, not the operating system clipboard. Preserve Clipboard, Fallout 4, F4SE, MCM, HUDFramework, TIM, Runtime Database and CommonLibF4RD. Preserve the proper mod name Condition Boy/Girl literally; it is not a generic status-indicator description.

Players select existing world objects using a manual selection weapon or geometric/workshop/cell/plugin methods. Selection only marks objects; Clear Selection deselects them. Destroy Selection destroys selected objects; Destroy Tool removes the Clipboard device. Preserve that distinction in every action and confirmation.

Copy/export saves a selected construction layout as a pattern in a numbered disk slot. Paste/import places or reuses objects from that saved blueprint, then initializes workshop callbacks, physics, wires and electrical power. Pattern means a reusable construction layout, not a repeating texture; slot is a numbered saved-layout location, not an equipment slot.

A cell is an engine world-space region. Workshop means the settlement's workbench/build system; workshop mode is the game's construction mode. Plugin means a loaded ESP/ESM/ESL mod file. Components are crafting/construction materials, not software modules.

Wires are electrical connections. Reconnecting power, initializing imported object animations and disabling Havok physics are distinct operations. Animated objects need not be generators and may have sound or an activator, both or neither. Keyframed motion fixes an object's physical transform. Hidden/helper/marker objects may be filtered; allowing selection/export differs from allowing import of filtered light sources.

Import may place some objects yet fail to finish physics, callbacks, wires or power. Retain every warning, partial-success qualification and instruction. Returned callbacks are finished function invocations; outstanding callbacks remain unfinished. Do not describe uncertain completion as success.

Menu buttons should be concise and consistent. Interpret each record using its full sentence, source context, record type and editor ID; use the standard Fallout 4 terminology of the target language where applicable. Do not merely substitute dictionary words.

Placeholders and Bethesda aliases are supplied at runtime and cannot be inflected or translated. Use natural numeral-neutral count wording for 0, 1 and larger values when the engine cannot select a grammatical form. Keep angle/degree symbols, signs, dimensions, technical filenames, settings, console commands and version numbers exact.

Preserve source line breaks and leading/trailing spaces. Some warnings intentionally end with a space for concatenation. Preserve complete HTML/Bethesda tags literally in the translated data; do not add tags. A language-neutral Clipboard MCM brand header is handled directly in config and is outside this translation corpus.

In compound display names such as Clipboard Tool or Clipboard Selection Gun, keep only Clipboard as the proper brand; translate the generic device/weapon descriptor naturally. These are in-game physical objects, not software commands.

For docs surface only: these are complete end-user guides, not developer notes. Translate headings and prose naturally, preserve every qualification, list item and number, and do not add release-candidate or testing-status commentary. Preserve all version numbers, file paths, keys, credit names and technical identifiers literally. Physical line wrapping may change, but do not insert extra blank-line paragraphs. Preserve numbered steps 1 through 5, 500 slots, slots 1 through 10, distance 5,000 units, and the 128-object truncation reference where they occur. Use unambiguous regional numeric formatting.

For docs surface only: documentation_ui_labels supplies exact labels already used by the game in this locale. Where the English guide names one of these MCM options or its section, reproduce the supplied target label verbatim so users can find it, while adapting the surrounding sentence. Do not retranslate the quoted label differently.

For docs surface only: localized guides live in Docs/clipboard/<language-code>/. Keep canonical English guide filenames in translation data; package generation replaces guide filenames and their same-folder references with the configured localized names. In the license paragraph use ../LICENSE.txt and ../Licenses for the shared canonical license and third-party notices. Do not translate the license text or create legal terms.
